name: Cel shading
summary: A render method that maps the light on a 3D surface to 2 or 3 flat tones and draws ink outlines, so 3D looks like a drawn animation cel.
how: Quantise the light value into 2 or 3 bands with a hard edge.
Draw outlines 1–4 px wide on silhouettes, by an inverted hull or an edge filter.
Keep base colours flat; carry the shape with the bands and the lines.

origin.note: Smilebit's Jet Set Radio is the first widely known cel-shaded game.

adoptions.via: Studios render 3D vehicles and sets with toon shaders to match hand-drawn animation.
